subject.title: chore(autoreview): sync hardened org review defaults

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the canonical autoreview interface that removes four reviewer engines and changes the default Codex model to Sol/high with Terra access fallback?
rationale: Canonical parity and code quality establish that the synchronization is correctly implemented, but they cannot establish maintainer acceptance of deliberate interface and operational-default changes.

options.title: Adopt current canonical policy
options.body: Merge the exact tree and accept Codex, Claude, and Pi plus Sol/high with narrow Terra fallback as the supported organization-wide workflow.

options.title: Revise policy upstream
options.body: Define any desired compatibility, deprecation, or fallback adjustment in openclaw/agent-skills and then resynchronize OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Adopt current canonical policy
recommendation.body: Merge the exact tree and accept Codex, Claude, and Pi plus Sol/high with narrow Terra fallback as the supported organization-wide workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current synchronization and authored the latest canonical policy and isolation changes, with steipete as the adjacent defaults and security owner.
